date-format.invalid: Use a date pattern such as dd/MM/yyyy or yyyy-MM-dd

time-format.label: Time format

public-url.title: Public address
public-url.description: The address people use to reach BoardGameTracker; email links and single sign-on point to it.
public-url.label: Public URL
public-url.not-set: Not set. Invitation and password-reset emails are not sent, and single sign-on uses the address you open the app on.
public-url.insecure-warning: The public URL uses http while BoardGameTracker is opened over https. Links in emails, RSVP invitations and single sign-on redirects will use the insecure address.
public-url.host-mismatch-warning: The public URL points to a different host than {{host}}. Links in emails, RSVP invitations and single sign-on redirects will use that host.
public-url.sso-warning: Single sign-on stops working with an http address.

sso-confirm.title: Stop single sign-on?
sso-confirm.description: With this public URL single sign-on stops working for everyone, also over https, until the public URL uses https again.

general.title: General settings
general.description: Change the general settings of the application.

enabled.label: Enable Shelf of Shame
enabled.description: Track games that haven't been played in a while.

enabled.label: Enable game nights
enabled.description: Plan game nights and collect RSVPs.

rsvp-authentication.label: Require authentication for RSVPs
rsvp-authentication.description: Only signed-in users can answer invitations.

version-track.label: Version track
version-track.description: Choose to stay on stable releases or switch to beta releases to get early access to new features.

beta.label: Beta
beta.description: Get beta releases with early access to new features.

enabled.label: Enable update check
enabled.description: Checks for new versions and shows them in the sidebar.

confirm.title: Reset data
confirm.description: Deletes all games, sessions, players, locations, loans, game nights, badges, images and uploaded manuals. Settings and user accounts stay. This cannot be undone.

confirm.title: Factory reset
confirm.description: Deletes all data, settings and user accounts, and signs you out. This cannot be undone.
confirm.admin-account: The admin account comes back with its first-login password.

shelf-of-shame.title: Shelf of Shame
shelf-of-shame.description: When a game counts as unplayed

bgg.title: BoardGameGeek API
bgg.description: An API key lets you search and import games and your collection from BoardGameGeek.

api-key.label: BGG API key
api-key.clear-hint: Save settings to apply the removal.
api-key.read-only: The API key is read only.
api-key.read-only-description: The API key is managed via the BGG_API_KEY environment variable and cannot be changed here.
api-key.help-description: Get a key from the BoardGameGeek <requestPage>request page</requestPage>.

current-password.label: Current password
current-password.placeholder: Needed to change your email address

password.title: Change password
password.description: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
password.min-length: Password must be at least 4 characters

temp-password.title: Temporary password
temp-password.description: Password reset for "{{username}}". Save this password — it won't be shown again.

delete.title: Delete user
delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete "{{username}}"? This cannot be undone.

access.title: Sign-in access
access.disable-hint: Disabling ends every session and blocks sign-in with a password and with single sign-on. Removing someone at the identity provider does not do this for you.
access.sso-none: No identity provider account is linked.
access.unlink-confirm: This identity provider account can no longer sign in as “{{username}}” until it is linked again.
access.role-managed: The role follows the identity provider's groups on every sign-in.
access.role-local: The role was set here and the identity provider does not change it.
access.manage-role: Let the identity provider manage the role

disable-confirm.title: Disable {{username}}?
disable-confirm.description: They are signed out on every device and can't sign in until you enable them.

notifications.password-change-failed: Failed to change password. Check your current password.
notifications.external-login-unlink-failed: Failed to unlink the identity provider account
notifications.role-manage-failed: Failed to hand the role to the identity provider

external-logins.title: Single sign-on
external-logins.description: Sign in with your identity provider instead of a password.
external-logins.none: No identity provider account linked yet.

notifications.unlink-failed: The identity provider account could not be unlinked.
notifications.link-failed: The link could not be started.

external-logins.unlink-confirm: You will no longer be able to sign in with this provider until you link it again.

env-override: Set by the environment variable {{variable}}. Change it there to update this setting.

sso.title: Identity provider

description.empty: Let people sign in through your identity provider (Keycloak, Authentik, Authelia, Zitadel, Entra ID, …). Register a client there first (public, or confidential with a client secret), then fill in the details below.
description.configured: Provider {{name}} is configured. Changes apply to the next sign-in.
description.inactive: Provider {{name}} is configured but inactive: it needs an https public URL.

sso.https-required: Single sign-on requires HTTPS. Put BoardGameTracker behind a reverse proxy with TLS and set an https public URL.

name.label: Short name
name.rename-warning: Changing the short name changes the redirect URIs below. Register the new ones at your provider; linked accounts keep working.

authority.label: Authority (issuer URL)
authority.relink-warning: Changing the address unlinks every account linked to this provider. Users then sign in with their password and link it again from their profile; users without a password need one first.

client-secret.label: Client secret (optional)
client-secret.placeholder: Leave empty for a public client
client-secret.unchanged: Stored — leave empty to keep it

auto-provision.label: Create accounts on first sign-in
auto-provision.description: New people get an account with the default role automatically. When off, only linked accounts can sign in.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the sign-in button on the login page.

fields.role-sync: With a groups claim and admin group set, accounts created through the provider get Admin when they are in that group and the default role otherwise, on every sign-in. The last admin is never demoted.

discovery.ok: The provider answered and its issuer matches the authority.
discovery.issuer-mismatch: The provider answered, but reports issuer {{issuer}}. Use that value as the authority.
discovery.failed: The provider could not be reached or did not return a discovery document.

setup.title: Register at the provider
setup.description: Allow these redirect URIs on the client you created at your identity provider.
setup.public-url-warning: No public URL is configured, so the redirect URIs are derived from the current request ({{url}}). Set the public URL under General if that is not the address people use.
setup.https-pending: Available once the public URL uses https.

validation.name: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes (1–100 characters)
validation.scopes: At least the openid scope is required

sso.delete-description: Removing the provider also unlinks every identity provider account. People keep their local password if they have one.

notifications.save-failed: The provider could not be saved.
notifications.delete-failed: The provider could not be removed.

sso.https-required-locked: Single sign-on requires HTTPS. Put BoardGameTracker behind a reverse proxy with TLS and set an https public URL. Until then you can only switch the provider off.
